verdict.rationale: The xAI docs describe latency in token-streaming terms: Priority Processing typically gives lower time-to-first-token (TTFT) and faster inter-token latency (ITL). That implies token-by-token output and documents some latency behavior, but no evidence item explicitly documents text streaming (e.g., a stream parameter or SSE format) or sub-second response guarantees; the WebSocket streaming evidence covers speech-to-text, not text generation. missing for 10: explicit text-streaming API documentation (stream flag/SSE event format), baseline latency figures or SLAs for TTFT/ITL, sub-second full-answer modes, independent hands-on latency corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream responses token by token (or get sub-second full answers) with the latency behavior documented

citations.quote: Priority Processing gives your xAI API requests higher scheduling priority, which typically results in lower time-to-first-token (TTFT) and faster inter-token latency (ITL)
